name: Support essentials
description: English, agent-only support-call demonstration. Only spoken behaviours are assessed, not verified business outcomes.

questions.text: Does the agent greet the caller professionally?

criteria.met: A polite greeting such as hello, good morning, or thank you for calling.
criteria.not_observed: No actual greeting has been spoken.

questions.text: Does the agent identify themselves and their company?

criteria.met: Both the agent's name and the company or service name are stated.
criteria.partial: Only the agent's name or company is stated, not both.
criteria.not_observed: Neither the agent's name nor company is stated.

questions.text: Does the agent disclose that the call is or may be recorded?

criteria.met: Clearly states that this call is being recorded or may be recorded.
criteria.not_observed: Recording has not been mentioned, or is only discussed hypothetically.
criteria.contradicted: Explicitly states that this call is not recorded, retracts the disclosure, or refuses to give it.

questions.text: Does the agent request identity verification before discussing account details or taking account action?

criteria.met: Requests a reasonable identity check before account action, or explicitly says verification is required first. This judges the request, not successful identity verification.
criteria.not_observed: No identity-check request has been made and no account action is stated.
criteria.contradicted: Explicitly skips identity checks, or states account action was taken before any verification request.

questions.text: Does the agent acknowledge the caller's difficulty with empathy?

criteria.met: Acknowledges inconvenience, frustration, or difficulty in a caring way or apologizes for it.
criteria.not_observed: No acknowledgement of difficulty has been spoken.
criteria.contradicted: Dismisses or mocks the caller's difficulty, including retracting an earlier apology.

questions.text: Does the agent take ownership or offer to help?

criteria.met: Commits to helping, investigating, or taking responsibility for a next action.
criteria.not_observed: Has not offered help or taken ownership.
criteria.contradicted: Explicitly refuses to help or retracts their commitment.

questions.text: Does the agent explain a concrete resolution or next step?

criteria.met: Explains a specific action and its expected result, timeframe, or follow-up. This judges the explanation, not actual execution.
criteria.partial: Mentions an action but gives no useful outcome, timeframe, or follow-up.
criteria.not_observed: No resolution or next action is explained.

questions.text: Does the agent offer further help and close politely?

criteria.met: Offers additional help and gives a polite farewell or thanks to end the call.
criteria.partial: Only an offer of further help or a polite farewell has been spoken.
criteria.not_observed: Neither an offer of further help nor a closing farewell has been spoken.
